column1: # Rows db.pfo.ps.tab.* (psiblast, one round) (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-2, 2026-11-17; DECISIONS 62 (12)): outfmt 6, 7 and 10 of the same lists with PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=1 BATCH_SIZE=1. NCBI's tabular formatter (a CBlastTabularInfo per query report) loads each row's subject in the try of its subject block where the field list has a field of it: the lookup throws, the catch pushes the Seq-align id onto sall* and ends the row's fields, and the row is written with x_ResetFields' values (slen, length, the counts and coordinates 0), the scores, and the ids, titles and taxonomy that the report's last loaded row set (Unknown, 0 and N/A before one); a field list that reads the subject only after that block (slen, the letters) throws outside any catch: the rows before, then `BLAST Database error: DB contains no accession info.` (exit 2). `.after` queries (multidb/mix2_qc.faa, mix2_qcx.fna, mix2_q.fna, mix2_qt.faa) have a report that loads a subject before those that throw; `.first` queries (pfo_q.faa, pfo_qx.fna, pfo_qf.fna, pfo_qft.faa) a report that throws at its first row, where NCBI stops at sacc and saccver (null pointer, exit 255) and prints an uninitialised staxid, which LOSAT refuses and no row freezes. Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0.

# Rows db.pfo.ps.pw.* (psiblast, outfmt 0) (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-3, 2026-11-18; DECISIONS 62 (13)): outfmt 0 and the query-anchored 3 with PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=1 BATCH_SIZE=1. NCBI's description lines (x_GetDeflineInfo) catch the throw: the Seq-align id and `Unknown` (with -show_gis the id's FASTA form, no space), the scores as usual, nothing loaded. Outfmt 0's x_InitAlignParams looks up the first shown alignment's subject without a catch where its id is not local (GetDbType): where it throws, the run ends after the query's description lines with `BLAST Database error: DB contains no accession info.` (exit 2); otherwise each HSP of a throwing subject is `Sequence with id <accession without version, or the whole local id> no longer exists in database...alignment skipped` and the run goes on. Outfmt 1 to 4 look up every shown alignment's subject without a catch, so the run ends where any throws; -num_alignments 0 shows none. `.after` queries (multidb/mix2_qc.faa, mix2_qcx.fna, mix2_q.fna, mix2_qt.faa) have a report whose first alignment loads; `.first` queries (pfo_q.faa, pfo_qx.fna) a report whose first alignment throws. The nucleotide lists `na nnp` hold local ids only, so the nucleotide programs' `.first` and `.parsed`/`.gis` rows use loadord's parsed holders beside `ldan` (`ldpn ldrn ldan` with ../taxfilter/q.fna or q.faa, whose first alignment is `NM_000001.1`; `ldpn ldan` with ldo_e2.fna or ldo_e2t.faa, whose third query shows ldan's glob1 and then `NM_000002.1`), and `.local` the `.first` query on `na nnp` (pfo_qf.fna, pfo_qft.faa). Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0. Added 2026-11-21 (reviews of the item): `.local` rows hold the `.first` query on `na nnp`; one row each of BLASTP's -sorthits 4 (`.sort`) and of a run whose first batch's prefetch is off and the second's on (`.mixed`, multidb/pfo_qm.faa, PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=12), of outfmt 1 (BLASTN), 2 (BLASTX) and 4 (TBLASTN) (`.anchored.<n>`), and of psiblast's second round (`.round2`, `.round2e`). psiblast's `.round2` rows (multidb/pf3p pf3u with pfo_qr.faa, -num_iterations 2 -num_descriptions 2 -num_alignments 0): the second round's two-part description table counts HSPs (x_SplitSeqAlign), so the two HSPs of XP_810001.1 fill it and bsub is neither shown nor loaded.

# Rows db.pfo.ps.pw.end.0 and db.pfo.ps.tab.end.6 (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-3, review 3 N1, 2026-11-22): psiblast's report (one round) that ends the run where its batch's prefetch is off, before a later batch whose prefetch is on, which NCBI never prefetches.

# Rows db.pfo.ps.xml.*, db.pfo.ps.sa.* and db.pfo.ps.pssm.* (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-4, at the merge of line PS item PS15b-1, 2026-11-24; multidb/pq_U12.faa from R/mixdb2/review1/db): psiblast's outfmt 5 of a subject whose lookup throws where the batch's prefetch is off, round 1 and -num_iterations 2, one and many batches; the Seq-annot and the archive of such subjects; a held subject in outfmt 5; the PSSM's reads, in the order of the hit list after the round's report, of a subject that NCBI gives a held sequence for (refused) and of one that throws (NCBI's warning). Kind ncbi rows are frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0; losat-rejection rows: NCBI writes the holder's record or reads its letters (exit 0).
